q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit in a row facing north. A sits at the extreme left, E at the extreme right, B is immediately right of A, and D is immediately left of E. Who sits in the middle?
exp: The arrangement is A-B-C-D-E. Therefore C sits in the middle.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A sits at the extreme left and F at the extreme right. B sits immediately right of A and E immediately left of F. Who sits third from the left?
exp: The arrangement is A-B-C-D-E-F. Therefore C is third from the left.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits immediately left of B, C sits immediately right of B, and D sits opposite B. Who sits immediately right of D?
exp: Fix B at a reference position. A is left of B, C is right of B, and D is opposite B. The remaining positions place E immediately right of D.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits immediately right of B, C sits immediately right of A, and D sits immediately left of B. Who sits immediately right of D?
exp: Around the circle the order is D-B-A-C-E. Therefore B sits immediately right of D.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. D sits in the middle. A sits immediately left of D, B immediately right of D, and G at the extreme right. Who can occupy the extreme left?
exp: D is fourth, A is third, B is fifth and G is seventh. The first position can be occupied by either C, E or F depending on the arrangement, so C is one possible answer.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A is at the extreme left and H at the extreme right. B is immediately right of A, and G is immediately left of H. C is immediately right of B. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: The arrangement starts A-B-C-D-E-F-G-H. Hence D is fourth from the left.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits immediately left of B and C immediately right of B. D sits immediately right of C. Who sits between A and D?
exp: The circular order is A-B-C-D-E. B lies between A and C, while C lies between B and D. Therefore the person between A and D along the shorter path is B-C, so among the options B is adjacent to A but not the sole person between them. The correct choice is not uniquely framed.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits immediately left of Q, R immediately left of S, and T opposite Q. Who sits immediately right of T?
exp: With Q fixed, T is opposite Q. The remaining arrangement places U immediately to the right of T.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. C is fourth from the left, B is immediately left of C, D immediately right of C, and A at the extreme left. Who is immediately right of D?
exp: C is fourth and D is fifth. Therefore the person immediately right of D is E.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. A is second from the left, B immediately right of A, F is second from the right, and E immediately left of F. Who sits at the extreme left?
exp: A is fixed at the second position, while B is third, E is fourth and F is fifth. Therefore the only person who can occupy the extreme left is C or D; the information is insufficient. Among the options, A is not possible, so the question is underdetermined.

q: Five persons A, B, C, D and E sit around a circular table facing the center. A is immediately right of B, C is immediately right of A, D is immediately right of C. Who sits immediately left of B?
exp: The circular order is B-A-C-D-E. Therefore E sits immediately left of B.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit in a row facing north. P is at the extreme left, U at the extreme right, Q immediately right of P, and T immediately left of U. R sits immediately right of Q. Who sits between R and T?
exp: The arrangement is P-Q-R-S-T-U. Therefore S sits between R and T.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite E. B is immediately left of A. C is immediately right of E. Who sits immediately right of B?
exp: B is immediately left of A, so A is immediately right of B.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite D. B is immediately right of A, and C is immediately left of D. Who sits opposite B?
exp: With A opposite D, B to the right of A and C to the left of D, the position opposite B is occupied by E.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits immediately right of Q, R immediately right of S, T opposite Q, and U immediately left of V. Who is definitely immediately right of Q?
exp: P is directly stated to be immediately right of Q.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. D is fourth from the left. A is second to the left of D, B immediately right of D, and F immediately left of G. If C is at the extreme left, who sits immediately right of A?
exp: D is fourth, so A is second. Therefore the person immediately right of A is the person in the third position, which is not fixed uniquely by the remaining clues. Hence D is not logically determined; the question is underconstrained.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A is third from the left, B immediately right of A, H at the extreme right, and G immediately left of H. C sits immediately left of D. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: A is third and B is immediately right of A. Therefore B is fourth from the left.

q: Seven persons P, Q, R, S, T, U and V sit in a row facing north. S is fourth from the left. P is second to the left of S, Q immediately right of S, and V at the extreme right. Who sits immediately left of Q?
exp: Q is immediately right of S, so S is immediately left of Q.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in two parallel rows of four each. Row 1 faces south and Row 2 faces north. A, B, C and D sit in Row 1, while E, F, G and H sit in Row 2. A is opposite E, B opposite F, and C opposite G. Who sits opposite D?
exp: The first three opposite pairs are A-E, B-F and C-G. Therefore D is opposite H.

q: Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F sit in two rows of three each. Row 1 faces south and Row 2 faces north. A is in the middle of Row 1, B is to the left of A, and D sits opposite A. E is immediately right of D. Who sits opposite B?
exp: Since B is left of A in the south-facing row, the corresponding position in the north-facing row is the right-hand position. With D opposite A and E to D's right, F occupies the position opposite B.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P is opposite T. Q is immediately left of P. R is immediately right of T. S is second to the right of Q. Who sits immediately left of T?
exp: P is opposite T. The stated relative placements determine P as the immediate left neighbor of T in the resulting arrangement.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits between B and G. C is second to the right of B. D is immediately right of C. E is immediately left of G. Who sits opposite A?
exp: Fix A between B and G. Applying the remaining right/left constraints places F at the position opposite A.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table. A, B, C and D face the center, while E, F, G and H face outward. A is opposite E. B is immediately right of A. F is immediately right of E. Who sits opposite B?
exp: A is opposite E. With B immediately right of A and F immediately right of E, the person opposite B is H.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table. P, Q and R face the center, while S, T and U face outward. P is immediately left of Q. R is opposite T. S is immediately right of U. Who sits opposite Q?
exp: Using the mixed facing directions, the given placements lead to U occupying the position opposite Q.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the center. A is immediately right of B. C is immediately left of D. E is between B and C. F is opposite A. Who sits immediately left of G?
exp: After fixing A-B, C-D, E between B and C, and F opposite A, G occupies the position immediately right of F. Hence F is immediately left of G.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P is between Q and W. R is opposite P. S is immediately left of R. T is immediately right of W. Who sits immediately right of Q?
exp: Since P is between Q and W, P is immediately right of Q in the chosen orientation.

q: Seven persons A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit in a row facing north. D is in the middle. A is second to the left of D, G is second to the right of D, B is at the extreme left, and F is immediately right of B. Who is immediately left of G?
exp: D is fourth and G is sixth. Therefore the person immediately left of G is C at the fifth position.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P is at the extreme left and W at the extreme right. Q is second to the right of P. R is immediately right of Q. S is immediately left of T. U is immediately right of T. Who sits fifth from the left?
exp: P=1, Q=3, R=4, and W=8. S-T-U must occupy consecutive available positions among 5,6,7, making S fifth from the left.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite E. B is second to the left of A. C is immediately right of E. D is immediately left of E. Who is opposite B?
exp: Fix A opposite E. B is second left of A. Mapping the opposite position across the circle places G opposite B.

q: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T and U sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits immediately left of Q, R immediately right of Q, S opposite P, and T immediately left of S. Who sits immediately right of T?
exp: T is immediately left of S, so S is immediately right of T.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit in a row facing north. A is fourth from the left, B is second to the right of A, G is at the extreme left, and H at the extreme right. C is immediately left of D. Who can occupy the second position?
exp: A is fourth and B is sixth, while G and H are fixed at the ends. C-D must be consecutive, so F can occupy the second position in a valid arrangement.

q: Nine persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits fourth to the left of B. C sits immediately right of A. D sits second to the left of C. E sits opposite B. F sits immediately left of E. G sits between H and I. Who sits immediately right of D?
exp: Fix B and place A fourth left of B. C is immediately right of A, and D is second left of C. Applying the remaining placements fixes F immediately right of D.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A sits opposite E. B sits second to the left of A. C is immediately right of B. D is immediately left of E. F is immediately right of D. G sits between C and H. Who sits opposite C?
exp: With A opposite E, B second left of A, and C right of B, the position opposite C is fixed as H.

q: Nine persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X sit around a circular table facing the center. P sits third to the right of Q. R sits immediately left of P. S sits opposite Q. T sits second to the right of S. U sits immediately left of T. V sits between W and X. Who sits immediately right of R?
exp: R is immediately left of P, so P is immediately right of R.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table, with A, B, C and D facing the center and E, F, G and H facing outward. A is opposite E. B is immediately right of A. F is second to the right of E. C is immediately left of B. Who is opposite C?
exp: A is opposite E. B is right of A, and C is left of B, fixing C relative to A. Accounting for the opposite row gives H opposite C.

q: Nine persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I sit around a circular table facing the center. A is immediately left of B. C is third to the right of B. D is immediately left of C. E is opposite A. F is second to the right of E. G sits immediately left of H, and I sits between H and A. Who sits immediately right of F?
exp: Place A and B first, then C and D from B. With E opposite A and F second right of E, the remaining clues place G immediately right of F.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit around a circular table facing the center. P is opposite T. Q is second to the right of P. R is immediately left of Q. S is immediately right of T. U is second to the left of S. V sits between W and R. Who sits opposite R?
exp: Fix P opposite T, then Q right of P and R left of Q. Applying S and U around T places V opposite R.

q: Nine persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I sit in a row facing north. A is fifth from the left. B is immediately left of A. C is third to the right of B. D is immediately right of C. E is at the extreme right. F is immediately left of G. H is at the extreme left. Who sits fourth from the left?
exp: A is fifth, B is fourth, and C is third to the right of B, so C is seventh. Therefore the fourth position is B, not C; the option list makes B the correct answer.

q: Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W sit in a row facing north. P is third from the left. Q is immediately right of P. R is second to the left of P. S is immediately left of T. U is immediately right of T. V is at the extreme right. Who sits between R and P?
exp: R is first and P is third, so the second position lies between them. The remaining clues do not uniquely identify the occupant, so W is only one possible choice; the question is underdetermined.

q: Nine persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H and I sit around a circular table facing the center. A is opposite E. B is immediately left of A. C is immediately right of E. D is second to the right of B. F is immediately left of D. G sits between H and I. Who sits opposite B?
exp: After fixing A opposite E, B left of A and D second right of B, the position opposite B is occupied by G after placing F and the H-I pair consistently.

q: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the center. A is third to the right of B. C is immediately left of A. D is opposite B. E is immediately right of D. F is second to the left of C. G is immediately right of H. Who sits immediately left of E?
exp: E is immediately right of D, so D is immediately left of E.
